edges.reason: Fishing rod requires 3 sticks; only 4 given in inventory. Player must locate the forest area (confirmed by finding oak_leaves) to harvest wood for crafting additional sticks.
Spruce tree is adjacent to the oak tree in the forest. Player must find this area to harvest spruce logs, then craft planks for the trapdoor recipe (6 spruce planks → 2 trapdoors).
Diamond hoe requires 2 sticks. With only 4 sticks given and fishing rod consuming 3, player must craft additional sticks from logs found in the forest near oak_leaves.
Fishing rod consumes 3 of the 4 pre-given sticks, leaving only 1. Diamond hoe needs 2 sticks, so player must craft more from wood after the rod depletes the stick supply.
Black terracotta is enclosed in a stone chamber whose only entrance is blocked by soul_sand walls. Player must mine through soul_sand to physically access the terracotta.

Player must navigate within 6 blocks and face the canopy to confirm visual identification. Max_distance=6 requires actual navigation in this compact scene rather than line-of-sight from spawn.

Uses inventory_has because mining soul_sand drops the soul_sand item into the player's inventory. Player starts with no soul_sand. Soul sand drops itself when broken with any tool or by hand. The soul_sand corridor at z=6-9 is the only entrance to the terracotta chamber.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cactus top block is at (6, 2, 8) relative to spawn in the southeast desert area. Max_distance=6 requires the player to navigate to the southern zone and face the cactus to confirm visual identification.

Uses inventory_has because crafting paper (3 sugar_cane in horizontal row → 3 paper) results in paper appearing in inventory. Player starts with no paper. Sugar cane is available from the eastern water feature (9 canes across 3 columns of 3).

Uses inventory_has because crafting a fishing rod (3 sticks diagonal + 2 string vertical → 1 fishing_rod) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player starts with 4 sticks and 3 string but no fishing rod. This craft consumes 3 of 4 available sticks, creating the resource dependency for diamond_hoe.

Uses inventory_has because crafting spruce trapdoors (6 spruce_planks in 2x3 pattern → 2 spruce_trapdoors) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player starts with no spruce trapdoors. Requires multi-step crafting: harvest spruce logs → craft spruce planks → craft trapdoors.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a diamond hoe (2 diamonds top row + 2 sticks vertical below → 1 diamond_hoe) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player starts with 2 diamonds but must craft additional sticks from forest wood since fishing rod consumed 3 of 4 given sticks. Player starts with no diamond hoe.

Uses inventory_has because smelting raw_salmon in a furnace with coal fuel produces cooked_salmon which appears in inventory. Player starts with 1 raw_salmon and 4 coal but no cooked_salmon. This is a furnace smelting operation (independent task with no DAG prerequisites).

Uses inventory_has because mining black_terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into inventory. Player starts with an iron pickaxe and no black_terracotta. The terracotta is physically enclosed in a stone chamber accessible only through the soul_sand corridor, enforcing the mine_soul_sand → mine_black_terracotta dependency through scene geometry.

scene_description: A compact multi-biome scene with enforced dependencies. North: forest area with oak and spruce trees providing wood for sticks and planks. East: water trench with sugar cane for paper crafting. South: a soul_sand corridor that physically gates access to a black_terracotta chamber (stone walls on all other sides). Southeast: open sand area with isolated cactus. Center: crafting table and furnace near spawn. The soul_sand corridor is the key structural element — a 3-block-deep wall of soul_sand is the ONLY entrance to the enclosed terracotta room.
task_text: Explore this multi-biome area to complete a series of crafting and gathering challenges: find oak leaves in the forest, craft paper from sugar cane, craft a fishing rod, cook salmon in the furnace, craft a spruce trapdoor, craft a diamond hoe, mine soul sand to access the hidden terracotta chamber, mine black terracotta, and find a cactus in the desert area.

NORTH (z negative): Oak tree at (-5, 1-4, -8) with leaf canopy at y=4-6, spruce tree at (-8, 1-4, -10) with leaves at y=4-6. EAST (x positive): Water trench at y=-1 with sand banks; sugar cane on sand at x=5, y=-1 (adjacent to water at y=-1), growing from y=0 to y=2. SOUTH (z positive): Stone structure from z=5 to z=14 containing soul_sand corridor (z=6-9, y=1-2, x=-1 to 1) leading to black_terracotta chamber (z=10-12). SOUTHEAST: Open sand area (z=6-10, x=5-8) with isolated cactus at (6, 1-2, 8). CENTER: Crafting table at (1,1,1) and furnace at (2,1,1) on grass ground. KEY MECHANICS: (1) Sugar cane: sand at y=-1 adjacent to water at y=-1 (same level) ✓. (2) Cactus: explicit air fill around cactus area ensures no adjacent blocks at y=1 ✓. (3) Soul sand corridor: stone fill first (y=1-3), then soul_sand overwrites at y=1-2 in z=6-9. After mining soul_sand, 2-high passage (y=1,y=2 become air) allows player to walk to terracotta ✓. (4) Terracotta chamber: stone walls on left (x=-1), right (x=1), and ceiling (y=3). Only entrance is through soul_sand face at z=6 ✓. (5) Crafting table/furnace at y=1 on grass at y=0 — accessible by right-clicking ✓. COMMAND ORDER VERIFICATION: The air fill at y=1-6 clears everything above ground first. Then specific structures are built. Soul_sand (y=1-2) overwrites stone (y=1-3) in the corridor positions. The explicit air fill in the cactus area (/fill ~5 ~1 ~6 ~8 ~3 ~10 minecraft:air) ensures no stone from the southern structure extends into the cactus zone. Cactus sand at (6,0,8) is set AFTER the sand fill, and cactus at (6,1,8) and (6,2,8) have air on all sides at those levels.
